section: NMZ & Sins of the Father prep

steps.title: NMZ your combats till a lvl …
steps.text: NMZ your combats till a lvl that you feel comfortable doing sins of the father with (85 combat so you can use nieve is recommended)

steps.title: Use black demon, tree spirit, khazard …
steps.text: Use black demon, tree spirit, khazard warlord, count draynor and bouncer

steps.title: Get 62 woodcutting
steps.note: Chop teak trees - 1.5-tick teaks on Fossil Island is the fastest in game. AFK/no-tick: teaks to 65 then sulliuscep mushrooms.

steps.title: Get 60 fletching
steps.note: Cut & string the best bows you can (oak->willow->maple->yew->magic), or fletch darts in 'zero time' while questing/Slayer/Agility.

steps.title: Get 49 slayer (88k xp)
steps.note: Use Vannaka (Edgeville Dungeon, 40 cb), then Chaeldar in Zanaris (70 cb, needs Lost City).

steps.title: Get 49 magic
steps.note: Fastest: enchant gem-tipped bolts (expensive). Cheaper passive: cast Low Level Alchemy from 21 while doing other things.

steps.title: Get 40 herblore
steps.note: Make the highest potion you can as you level: Attack (3) -> Strength (12) -> Energy (26) -> Prayer (38). Quests skip the early grind.

steps.title: Get 5 construction
steps.note: Build crude chairs -> bookcases -> oak larders in your POH (bring saw, hammer, steel nails); Mahogany Homes is a cheaper alternative.
